newsitem.title: GREECE: NATL BANK/GREECE TO CUT BASE DEPO RATE BY 50BPS.
newsitem.headline: NATL BANK/GREECE TO CUT BASE DEPO RATE BY 50BPS.

text.p: The National Bank of Greece will cut its base deposit rate by 50 basis points to 11.5 percent and its working capital loan rate by 100 basis points to 17.75 percent effective Monday, a high-level National Bank source told Reuters.

The National Bank , the country's largest commercial bank, will also reduce its mortgage, consumer, credit card and long-term lending rates for fixed assets by 50 basis points effective Monday, the source said.
It will also decrease its deposit rate for current balances by 50 basis points to 10 percent.

"Following the central bank's move to slash its intervention bid in overnight funds by 20 basis points to 12.40 percent yesterday, the third cut in a month, the drop in T-bill rates by 10 basis points and the continuing capital inflows, the National Bank decided to reduce these deposit and lending rates," the source said.
The formal announcement will be made later today, the source said.
